class.jaymoskingdoms.option.counterspell: When a foe raises a spell and the sigil turns at their feet, snuff it with a gesture. It needs no words, and it can fail.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.dispel.desc: Ends a lasting spell or curse on whoever or whatever you are looking at, or the ground magic under your gaze. Costs a pinch of diamond dust. A boss may shrug it off.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.ward_line.de: A line of silver thread across the way you face. It chimes when anything crosses it, and keeps a camp's watch for ten minutes. Can be cast as a ritual.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.find_magic.d: Whatever is magical near you glimmers, for your eyes alone. Can be cast as a ritual.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.identify.des: Shows what the thing in your hand hides: every enchantment, any curse, any element in it. Costs an ender pearl. Can be cast as a ritual.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.speak_animal: For ten minutes the beasts near you say what is on their minds. Sneak and use on one to hear it. Can be cast as a ritual.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.hut.desc: A dome of force for one night. Arrows turn back at it, beasts are kept out, the rain does not come in. Costs an ender pearl.
Fills the pot, cauldron or chest you look at with plain bread.
Cleans spoiled or poisoned food in your hands and in the pot or chest you look at.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.feather_fall: You and the friends beside you drift down gently for a while.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.spider_climb: Walk up walls for a minute. A held spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.water_walk.d: Walk on water for a while. Costs a bit of kelp, or a focus.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.long_jump.de: Your jumps carry you much farther and higher for a while.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.misty_step.d: Blink a few blocks the way you look, in a puff of silver mist.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.web.desc: A sticky web where you look. Whoever blunders into it is slowed, and may be caught like in a net. Fire burns it away. A held spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.grease.desc: Slick the ground where you look. Whoever hurries across it may trip. Fire burns it away.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.fog.desc: A bank of fog where you look. Whoever stands in it cannot see, and nothing outside it can see them. A held spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.darkness.des: A sphere of magical darkness that nobody can see through. A held spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.silence.desc: A bubble of silence. Nobody inside can speak a spell. A held spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.spike_growth: A patch of thorns that cuts anyone who moves through it. A held spell.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.magic.title: Everyday magic
gui.jaymoskingdoms.magic.rituals: Rituals (ten seconds still, a book open)
gui.jaymoskingdoms.magic.whisper_hint: Words to whisper to who you look at
magic.jaymoskingdoms.identify.title: What it hides
message.jaymoskingdoms.cantrip.nothing.l: The light needs a staff, wand, tome or holy symbol in your hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cantrip.nothing.w: Look at someone and write what to whisper.
message.jaymoskingdoms.parts.gagged: You cannot speak the words with a gag on.
message.jaymoskingdoms.parts.silenced: No sound carries here. The words will not come.
message.jaymoskingdoms.parts.deafened: You cannot hear your own words. The spell falls apart.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ritual.book: Hold a book open for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.scroll.fizzle: The words slip away. The scroll crumbles.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.weather.rain_ends: This rain will be gone by tomorrow.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.weather.storm: A storm, and it may last.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.cow.1: The other cow is looking at my grass.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.cow.2: Is it milking time? It feels like milking time.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.pig.0: Mud is the best of all the things.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.pig.1: Is that a carrot? Say it is a carrot.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.pig.2: I knew a pig once who saw the world. He is gone now.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.sheep.1: My wool is heavy and my heart is light.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.sheep.2: Do not tell the wolves where we sleep.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.chicken.0: Egg! Egg! No. Not yet. Egg.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.chicken.1: Something went over. Something big. Hide.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.chicken.2: I am the boss of this corner.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.horse.0: There is a long road in me, if you want it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.horse.1: Carry on. I will carry you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.wolf.0: The pack remembers who feeds it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.wolf.1: I smelled a stranger on the wind.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.wolf.2: Stay close. The night is long.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.cat.1: The mouse knows. The mouse always knows.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.cat.2: Mine. The sunny spot is mine.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.fox.0: I know a burrow with eggs in it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.fox.1: The hens count their own. Mostly.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.rabbit.1: The hawk is not in the sky today. I checked twice.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.other.0: Something is different about the air today.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.other.1: You can hear me. That is rare.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.other.2: Be kind and I will remember.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.hurt.0: It hurts. Please, a little help.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.animal.baby.1: Stay with me. Please stay with me.
